params.prompt: Korean webtoon / instatoon 2D illustration style for a mobile app ad, square 1:1: clean bold dark outlines, flat cel shading with soft gradients, bright saturated colors, expressive cute cartoon. NOT 3D. STRICT COMPOSITION: all characters and objects are in the LOWER part: their top edge below 36% of the image height, bottom around 86%. Upper 34% only background. No money, no coins, no logos. Draw the mascot from the reference image as a 2D webtoon character (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M). Scene: a large cartoon smartphone, screen facing viewer, showing a realistic Korean insurance app comparison screen (clean UI) with these exact Korean texts only: top title '또래 보장 비교'; a small legend '나' (red dot) and '또래 평균' (orange dot); a grouped bar chart with four categories labeled '암', '뇌', '심장', '수술' where every red bar (나) is shorter than the orange bar (또래 평균); at the bottom a red rounded button '부족한 보장 확인'. A red notification badge with a question mark symbol near the chart. Meri stands beside the phone looking at it puzzled, hand on chin. Background: 2D illustrated warm orange to coral pink gradient with soft light beams and small sparkles.
